lifecycleAndWatchCorrection20261030.sourceScope: Remaining readable activation lines 1-400 and 577-1005 reviewed, completing the body alongside previously selected 400-576. Entire 533-line garrisonTick body inspected. Source scheduler registration, external helpers and whole Conductor graph remain incomplete.
findings: Activation enumerates up to 501 positions per building across an uncapped nearestObjects result; tests 24 bearings per position and low/front/side/rear cover. This work is not suitable for direct copy into the bounded owner callback.

Candidate firing watch uses eye-height ASL. Medic prefers covered interior, MG/marksman/observer favour field of fire and height; rifle/AT actors may take close perimeter patrol. Raw height or role order alone does not reproduce this intent.

Walking tick still setPosATL snaps actors within 2 m, before doStop/PATH lock. Optional stuck teleport also exists; neither is adopted. Medical return and displaced-post retries reset progress clocks and issue broad policy writes.

Static and turret MANNED require actual gunner/turretUnit. Boarding timeout fallback applies only to source WAYPOINT and only ASSIGNED status; a later dismount from MANNED has no replacement transition. External yield unassigns without exact native assignment receipt. These are not sufficient CBE lifecycle contracts.

Current CBE arrival watch used getPos [50,bearing], whose alternative syntax returns ground-level Z. This loses upstairs eye altitude and incorrectly follows remote terrain height. Repair only the existing interior watch endpoint in ASL using actual eyePos, then ASLToAGL at endpoint; preserve existing bearing, range, arrival/authority guards, exterior observation and release.

implementation.scope: Interior settled-watch coordinate correction only. No role-aware allocator, static/turret garrison task, clear-fire proof, new controller, geometry query, native movement or renewed deadline.
